Blind design critic for piece=type-system round=r2.

Inspect REAL files:
- Ours: gauntlet/pieces/type-system/r2/ (home-desktop.png, home-mobile.png, blog-or-type-specimen.png, NOTES.md)
- Prior r1 for reference only
- Bar: gauntlet/bar/*/home-desktop.png especially eftakher, ericsin, dai-is-a-dev, pablostanley, loganliffick, evilrabbit, pham-codes
- Criteria: gauntlet/bar/WIN_CRITERIA.md and gauntlet/critics/type-system-r1.md (r1 lost)

R2 claimed Fraunces display ~79px. Blind A/B vs strongest bar type. Write gauntlet/critics/type-system-r2.md with:
piece, round, winner (us|bar|tie), biggest_gap, next_build_instruction, evidence_paths[], blind_ab_note

I’m using the caveman skill in ultra mode for the blind, evidence-first critique. I’ll inspect the specified images and criteria, then write the r2 verdict directly to the requested critic file.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/gauntlet/critics/type-system-r2.md
+piece: type-system
+round: r2
+winner: bar
+biggest_gap: >-
+  Fraunces is genuinely loaded, but it is not doing enough identity work. The
+  79px title is a narrow, ordinary two-line serif block stranded in a huge
+  empty viewport; the pill nav and four outlined social controls add generic
+  portfolio chrome. Eftakher and Ericsin make display type the composition,
+  while Pham and Evil Rabbit commit to a recognizable mono surface. Our type
+  has contrast, not authorship. Mobile repeats the same problem with a large
+  dead zone above the title. The file named blog-or-type-specimen.png is a blog
+  index, not a three-level specimen, so the claimed system is not evidenced.
+next_build_instruction: >-
+  Recompose the first viewport around an unmistakable Fraunces lockup: make
+  the name occupy roughly 40–50vw at 1440px (with an intentional break or
+  collision), put it at the visual entry point, and let body copy/meta follow
+  as secondary rhythm. Quiet the header to text-only or remove it, eliminate
+  the circular social-button row from the hero, and recapture a real specimen
+  plus a mobile hero where brand → voice → action survives without dead space.
+evidence_paths:
+  - gauntlet/pieces/type-system/r2/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/pieces/type-system/r2/home-mobile.png
+  - gauntlet/pieces/type-system/r2/blog-or-type-specimen.png
+  - gauntlet/pieces/type-system/r2/NOTES.md
+  - gauntlet/pieces/type-system/r2/capture.ts
+  - gauntlet/bar/WIN_CRITERIA.md
+  - gauntlet/bar/eftakher/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/ericsin/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/dai-is-a-dev/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/pablostanley/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/loganliffick/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/evilrabbit/home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/bar/pham-codes/home-desktop.png
+blind_ab_note: >-
+  Blind pass: challenger was judged against unlabeled bar screenshots. Bar
+  wins first-glance ownability, display dominance, and authored surface. Our
+  warm grid is atmospheric, but its cyan mark plus pill controls still reads
+  like a polished dark template; Fraunces alone does not close the gap.
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
